summary: OIDC IDP swap breaks support-tool impersonation: session binding mismatch after IdP migration
description:
Issue summary:
A recent IdP migration (Okta tenant swap for some test tenants) appears to have introduced OIDC token-binding header changes that break service-account impersonation flows used by internal support tooling. Users attempting to impersonate customer service sessions or escalate runbook access receive 401/403 during token exchange.

Impact:
- Multiple on-call engineers could not impersonate customer sessions via the support tool between 18:15–19:10 UTC on 2026-03-12.
- Blocked urgent troubleshooting for two P0 customer incidents that required session-level tracing.
- Support-tool UI showed "Impersonation failed: invalid_token_binding" and backend logs show OIDC token exchange rejections.

Environment:
- prod-us-east auth-proxy cluster behind identity-sync service.
- Affected users primarily in SSO group: support-tool-users@redwood.internal (Okta tenant A migrated to new IdP relay).

Steps to reproduce:
1) Log in to console via Okta tenant A (migrated to new relay).
2) Open support-tool and attempt "Impersonate user" for a customer session.
3) Observe support-tool UI error and auth-proxy logs showing token validation failure after OIDC /token call.

Observed behavior:
- /token endpoint returns 401 with body: {"error":"invalid_token_binding","error_description":"token binding header mismatch: 'x-idp-binding' expected 'okta-v1' got 'okta-relay-v2'"}
- Support-tool fails before obtaining impersonation session cookie; no resident session created.

Expected behavior:
- Support-tool should accept legal, exchanged tokens for impersonations across supported IdP relays when token binding semantics are compatible or a transparent mapping exists.

Relevant logs/snippets:
- auth-proxy (18:17:42 UTC): auth-proxy: token_validation.go:143: token exchange failed: invalid_token_binding expected=okta-v1 actual=okta-relay-v2 request_id=req-4b6f
- identity-sync (18:16:55 UTC): identity-sync: relay-mapper.go:57: updated idp-metadata for tenant=tenant-a idp_relay_prefix=okta-relay-v2 commit=gh-1301

Notes:
- Migration runbook was executed earlier on 2026-03-12; partial rollout to tenant-a was intentional.
- No changes to support-tool code were deployed at the time of failure.
comments: 2026-03-12 18:30 - Asha Mehta (reporter): Notified SRE and Support. Observed identical errors across 3 engineers. Filing ticket and attaching request dumps.

2026-03-12 18:42 - Ethan Cole (assignee): I can reproduce locally against prod-auth-proxy with tenant-a metadata. Seems token-binding header constant changed post-migration. Creating temp mitigation to accept both prefixes.

2026-03-12 19:00 - SRE - Maria Gomez: Rolled a small auth-proxy config patch to map okta-relay-v2 -> okta-v1 for tenant-a. Monitoring for further failures. Linked incident on #support. Dashboards: https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/auth-proxy-errors?from=now-1h
2026-03-12 19:08 - Customer-facing support (via #support): Confirmed impersonation requests succeed after mapping. Will keep ticket open for root cause and a permanent fix.

2026-03-13 09:10 - Identity team - Jun Park: The relay prefix change was introduced by identity-sync PR gh-1301 to support new Okta relay header naming. We didn't include compatibility shim for impersonation token binding. Working on follow-up PR to normalize headers during rollout.
investigation:
Hypotheses:
- Identity-sync migration changed idp_relay_prefix header value without adding compatibility mapping in auth-proxy.
- Token-binding enforcement in auth-proxy is strict and rejects tokens with unexpected binding values.
What we checked:
- Confirmed identity-sync updated idp metadata for tenant-a (PR gh-1301).
- Reproduced token-binding mismatch in a staging replica by swapping idp_relay_prefix.
- Verified no support-tool code changes occurred.
Dashboards / traces checked:
- auth-proxy 5xx/4xx spike (18:15–18:45 UTC) on prod-us-east.
- Sentry errors: support-tool:ImpersErr rate x3.
resolution:
Mitigation applied (2026-03-12 18:50 UTC): temporary compatibility mapping in auth-proxy to accept 'okta-relay-v2' as equivalent to 'okta-v1' for tenant-a.
Root cause: identity-sync rollout updated the idp_relay_prefix header naming without coordinating an auth-proxy compatibility mapping for token binding semantics.
Permanent fix: identity team to land gh-1322 which normalizes relay prefixes and adds a migration-mode toggle. Auth-proxy will be updated to accept legacy and new prefix forms for 30 days during rollout.
workaround: If you hit the error, retry impersonation after 18:50 UTC. Engineering applied compatibility mapping; if not yet applied for your tenant, escalation to SRE with request_id will be needed.
follow_up_actions:
1) Identity team to merge gh-1322 and schedule controlled rollout with migration toggle (owner: Jun Park, due: 2026-03-20).
2) Auth-proxy to add explicit mapping and unit tests for token-binding header permutations (owner: Ethan Cole, due: 2026-03-16).
3) Update IdP migration runbook to include auth-proxy compatibility verification step (owner: Runbooks, due: 2026-03-18).
4) Postmortem to be authored if customer impact > 30 minutes (owner: Asha Mehta).
service_impact_summary: Support-tool impersonation failed for tenant-a users for ~55 minutes; mitigated by auth-proxy compatibility mapping. No customer data leaked. Escalated because it blocked P0 troubleshooting during window.
